name: ATM Completion Acknowledgement V 03
definition: The ATMCompletionAcknowledgement message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMCompletionAdvice message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMCompletionAcknowledgement.name: ATM Completion Acknowledgement
ATMCompletionAcknowledgement.definition: Information related to the acknowledgement of an ATM completion on the ATM. manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
